summary: Consumer Portfolio Services filed an 8-K reporting the amendment and renewal of its revolving warehouse credit facility. The facility, with Citibank as agent, was increased from $335 million to $508 million, secured by automobile receivables, with advances up to 96% of eligible pledged receivables. The funding termination date is July 17, 2028. This is a routine refinancing of an existing credit line in the ordinary course of business, not a special situation. No new deal, acquisition, or restructuring is involved. The filing merely updates the company’s credit capacity.
